items.title: The universal property of the module of differentials: maps out are derivations
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that maps from the module of differentials into a module are the same as derivations, as an isomorphism of functors (statement lines 34072-34088, with the slogan that maps out of the differentials are derivations). The proof does not construct an inverse: it assembles a derivation into a map on the free module on the symbols and observes that the derivation conditions mean exactly that this map annihilates the relations defining the module of differentials (proof lines 34090-34097). Identifying the two sets of conditions is what proves the universal property. H2.
